title: DunbaaBERT: From Sacrifice to Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2605.26935v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models have achieved strong performance across many NLP tasks, yet Urdu remains comparatively underexplored due to limited resources and fragmented evaluation settings. To address this gap, we introduce DunbaaBERT, a family of Urdu RoBERTa-base models trained from scratch with Byte-BPE vocabularies of 32k, 52k, and 96k tokens on a deduplicated 17 GB Urdu corpus. We evaluate DunbaaBERT across intrinsic and downstream Urdu NLP benchmarks covering linguistic acceptability, news classification, offensive language detection, and sentiment analysis, while analyzing vocabulary-size effects on performance, pre-training dynamics, and computational efficiency. Across benchmarks, the DunbaaBERT variants achieve competitive performance against strong multilingual baselines while consistently maintaining favorable efficiency trade-offs. translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在众多NLP任务中已取得出色性能，但由于资源有限和评估环境碎片化，乌尔都语仍然相对缺乏研究。为填补这一空白，我们推出了DunbaaBERT，这是一系列从零开始训练的乌尔都语RoBERTa-base模型，使用32k、52k和96k词元的Byte-BPE词表，在经过去重处理的17 GB乌尔都语语料库上进行预训练。我们在涵盖语言可接受性、新闻分类、冒犯性语言检测和情感分析的内在与下游乌尔都语NLP基准上对DunbaaBERT进行评估，同时分析词表大小对性能、预训练动态和计算效率的影响。在各项基准测试中，DunbaaBERT的各个变体相比强大的多语言基线模型取得了具有竞争力的性能，并始终保持良好的效率权衡。在我们的受控实验设置下，增加词表大小并不能持续地提升……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文推出了DunbaaBERT——一系列使用不同大小Byte-BPE词表（32k/52k/96k）在17 GB去重乌尔都语语料上从零训练的RoBERTa-base模型，在多项乌尔都语基准上取得与强多语言基线相当的性能并保持更优的效率，同时发现增大词表并不能持续提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DunbaaBERT, a family of Urdu RoBERTa-base models trained from scratch with varying Byte-BPE vocabulary sizes (32k/52k/96k) on a deduplicated 17 GB Urdu corpus, achieving competitive performance against strong multilingual baselines with favorable efficiency trade-offs, and showing that larger vocabulary sizes do not consistently improve performance.
